lines.en: I crawl the slopes of the molten hills.
My feet cross warm stone.
Hot air bends my antennae.

lines.zh: 我绕过一道裂开的地缝。
lines.en: I skirt a split in the ground.
Gravel rolls away beneath me.
I hug the rock, wary of slipping.
Lava reddens my shadow.
I work my way downhill.
My shell is baked to a sheen.
I follow the ridge line.
I stop at a vent.
Heat rushes up from the crack.
I avoid the smoking pits.
I step on cooled pumice.
I brush through a patch of ash.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫起一小撮尘。
lines.en: My tail kicks up a little dust.
I press against a hot stone.

lines.zh: 我在丘顶听地底的声音。
lines.en: On the hilltop I listen below.

lines.zh: 熔岩山丘的灰，盖住我的壳。
lines.en: Molten hill ash coats my shell.
My segments open and close.
I wait for it to cool before moving.
Nothing else lives on these hills.
I slowly clean my antennae.
Lava flows below me.
I count the vents.
Fine cracks run on my shell.
The heat makes me drowsy.
I settle and draw my legs in.
You shouldn't be on these hills.
The ash is scorching your soles.
You stepped on my resting stone.
I'm foraging here.
You carry no heat.
The ground under you will give.
I raise my antennae to sense you.
The fungus on these molten hills is mine.
You're too near the fire.

lines.zh: 熔岩丘陵的热气，推我往前。
lines.en: The heat of the molten hills pushes me on.
My cap split; spores leak out.
I curl into a ball.
I got scorched.
The ash is too hot; my legs fail.
I rolled behind a stone.
I can still crawl with this.
Ash got into the wound.

lines.zh: 熔岩丘陵里吐出一口气。
lines.en: One breath out across the molten hills.
I withdraw into the fissure.

lines.zh: 熔岩山的风，烫得人发昏。
lines.en: The molten hills' wind is dizzyingly hot.
Is that something to eat?
What you hold is steaming.

lines.zh: 熔岩丘陵里，我成群长出来。
lines.en: On the molten hills, we sprout in pairs.
Put it on the rock, don't hand it over.
I crawl over and sniff it.
Too hot, wait a moment.
This would burn my mouthparts.
You know these hills after all.
A little nearer.
I circle halfway around that smell.

lines.zh: 熔岩丘陵的蘑菇，就是我的壳。
lines.en: A molten-hills mushroom is my whole shell.
I rolled behind a stone.
My shell scraped you.
Back off, there's no path here.
You knocked me down the slope.
I clutch a stone edge and climb back.
I can take that much.
Ash got in my eyes.
I tuck my legs and play dead.
You're pressed past the line.
I'm alone on these hills.
I hide my eggs in stone cracks.
Too much fire, not suited.
Find a cool stone first.
Wait until the vents quiet.
I'm not that sort of creature.
My shell is still soft.
Don't look, I'm shy.
I'd rather bask.
Move, I'm going to burrow.
A piece of volcanic rock, I hold it.
There's mineral in this ash.
I carry it with my mouthparts.
Too heavy, I can't drag it.
I roll it to my burrow.
Someone dropped something.
This smells of sulphur.
I tuck it under my body.
Things by lava are brittle.
Keep it for the nest.
This ash slope belongs to me.
I can charge from here.
I've drawn my legs in.
Lava is behind you.

lines.zh: 别踩我的菌盖，会喷孢子。
lines.en: Do not step on my cap; it will puff spores.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，引我过来。
lines.en: Your body heat drew me over.
When I move, the ash scatters.
The slope is narrow, you can't retreat.
My mouthparts are open.
You have one step left.
Then don't back away.
My gills open; time to act.
The spores fall first; then I move.

lines.zh: 熔岩山丘的菌盖，是我的伞。
lines.en: The molten-hill cap is my umbrella.
I close in along the ground.
Ash hides my outline.
When you turn, I stop.
I'm silently noting your steps.
The lava glow is in your eyes.
The gravel here is loose.
I move to your downhill side.
The ground under you is cracking.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳和石头一样色。
lines.en: My shell is the colour of stone.
Two steps more and you're at the edge.
One leap is all.
The instant you lift a foot, now.
You heard the gravel.

lines.zh: 孢子已经沾上你的裤脚。
lines.en: Spores already cling to your trouser leg.
I spring up and bite your ankle.
My mouthparts bite down.
That didn't carry much force.
You fling me onto the stone.
I flip over and crawl up again.
Ash is in the scratches.
I retreat into a fissure.
That little blood flustered you.
You missed a step.
On the molten hills, I dodged.
I crawl out of a lava crack.

lines.zh: 熔岩丘上多了一个影子。
lines.en: One more shadow on the molten hills.
The ash heap stirs.
I shake the ash off my shell.
The heat dries me out.
I climb onto a black stone.

lines.zh: 我的同伴还没从灰里冒头。
lines.en: My companions have not yet pushed out of the ash.
Lava runs below the hill.
I raise my antennae to probe.
Hot enough here.
I bear heat, but that fire was close.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，壳都花了。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope, shell scuffed.
Water seals me instantly.
The whole slope lifts.

lines.zh: 这东西钉进了我的节缝。
lines.en: That lodged between my segments.

lines.zh: 咒力把我的甲壳锁死了。
lines.en: Magic locks my shell tight.
Nothing to eat on these hills.
Lightning strikes, my shell crawls.
Not even heat in the void.
